question: What changes when inherited root stiffness and damping are excluded from the exact 90-tendon body?
hypothesis: Removing the inherited free-root spring/damper removes that artificial anchoring. Whether foot-only support improves is a separate open question.
integration_dependency: PR #14 diagnostics; use the pinned revision or an explicitly reviewed equivalent, not main by assumption.

units.force: native model force units; not animal-calibrated SI forces

budget_scope: Proposed outer ceiling for the paired study, excluding dependency installation. Not a measurement or an already-enforced runner feature. Enforce/verify before execution; do not automatically raise on failure.

intervention.legacy_anchored: Rebuild and verify the pinned body: root stiffness 0.4, six root damping entries 0.02.
intervention.unanchored_root_candidate: Explicitly derive a body with root stiffness and all root damping entries zero; preserve limb compliance. Source XML/assets remain untouched.
intervention.interpretation: Spring and damping are a declared combined treatment. Do not attribute all dynamic differences to either component alone. A later component-isolation study must be preregistered separately.

protocol: Before simulation, record candidate source SHA, environment, model/source asset/receipt hashes, and exact protected-file hashes. Use separate new workspaces and model identities for A and B.
Rebuild tendon-candidate receipts. Audit compiled root/limb parameters and the unchanged source assets; never patch a compiled model silently or force old checkpoint restoration.

Add analytic no-contact root translation and nonzero-velocity controls; isolate spring/damper components rather than expecting gravity or total force to vanish. Legacy must retain its measured response and candidate must lack those root components.

Run the same preregistered recorded pose, nine fixed placements, five contact depths and bounded dynamic controls for both variants. Preserve inherited force-accounting tolerances: gravity abs/rel 1e-10, passive absolute 1e-10, scaled dynamic residual 1e-9, source target abs/rel 1e-12.
Retain force budgets, full finite observations, foot/non-foot contacts, support target/LP status, warnings and elapsed/resource measurements for both variants, including failures.
Compare paired results and independently verify the specific claims. Do not close FE-02 or claim standing/walking from this comparison.
success_criterion: Engineering gate only: declared root intervention and all invariants verified, analytic controls pass, and paired finite force/support observations are reproducible. Support feasibility is a separately reported endpoint, not a condition to hide an otherwise valid negative finding.
falsification: Any unexplained model/parameter difference, failed legacy reproduction, residual inherited root spring/damper, force-accounting failure or invalid observation defeats the engineering comparison. Zero feasible poses is a valid negative endpoint only when comparison validity is established.

decision_table.invalid_comparison: Repair measurement/provenance first; no support-capability conclusion.
decision_table.valid_zero_feasible: Keep the corrected-model result and legacy control; test a separately preregistered front/middle/rear foot-placement or force-direction hypothesis. Do not infer impossibility outside this fixed grid.
decision_table.valid_feasible_pose: Proceed to a separate bounded dynamic hold protocol on the same muscle-body variant. Static feasibility does not certify stable standing.
decision_table.timeout_or_missing_dependency: Record inconclusive or blocked respectively; do not count as physical infeasibility.

before_execution: Implement the explicit variant and paired runner with enforced budgets.
Pin candidate code/model/data hashes and independent review notes before collecting comparison outcomes.
Validate any revised protocol as a new version before execution, never retrospectively adjust bounds.
non_goals: new external data or paid services
autonomous walking, biological equivalence or consciousness claims
handoff: One implementation owner claims issue #4, branch/base SHA and files; an independent verifier reviews outputs. This plan is neither a reservation nor an automatic scheduler.
